decided_by: R1 base composition (decisive): T at positions 27-28 is 97.93% / 97.79%, with poly-T immediately after 16bp barcode + 10bp UMI = 26bp. If v3, positions 27-28 should be random within the UMI, but that is not the case.
base_composition_note: Positions 20-26 are approximately random: A 20-22% / C 22-25% / G 19-23% / T 33-36%. From position 27 onward, T remains constant at around 98%.
kb_comparison_note: As assumed, the number of whitelist-matched barcodes is not a useful discriminator because the v3 list is large. p_pseudoaligned is also tied at 71.8% for both. The deciding factor is base composition.
